category_title: Students who avoid participation due to anxiety and low confidence
minimal_context: The student is asked to join a group board game that involves moving around the alphabet based on animal names.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We have a new board game today for the group. We are going to take turns moving around the alphabet based on animal names. Come join the circle.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Hesitates and stays away from the group) I don't want to play.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Come on, just sit down with everyone and give it a try.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No, I can't do it. It's a new game and I don't know how.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You just have to think of an animal name and move your piece. It's easy.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not doing it! I'll get it wrong and everyone in the class will look at me.

TUTOR: We have a new board game today for the group. We are going to take turns moving around the alphabet based on animal names. Come join the circle.

STUDENT: (Hesitates and stays away from the group) I don't want to play.

TUTOR: Come on, just sit down with everyone and give it a try.

STUDENT: No, I can't do it. It's a new game and I don't know how.

TUTOR: You just have to think of an animal name and move your piece. It's easy.

STUDENT: I'm not doing it! I'll get it wrong and everyone in the class will look at me.

task.content: Playing a board game involving moving around the alphabet based on animal names

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When faced with a new activity
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Initially unwilling to participate in a group game, despite considerable encouragement from Beehive staff
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Anxiety produced when faced with a new activity as well as anxiety about losing face in front of classmates if expectations were not met

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Reluctant to attempt new activities, hesitates a bit
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Fragile self-concepts, less resilient when faced with new or demanding situations
